policy_rationale: Fail a paired operation only when at least 18 of 21 index-paired candidate-minus-baseline samples are positive: P[Binomial(21, 0.5) >= 18] = 0.000745, below the Bonferroni alpha 0.05/18 = 0.002778. Runner noise shifts both interleaved sides and gives roughly half positive differences; 18 consistently positive pairs is evidence of a real slowdown. The pooled median delta is reported for audit, not gated.
